stops.note: an Algonquian term referring to Inuit peoples, later corrupted by European traders
Newfoundland English corruption of 'Esquimaux', applied to Arctic sled dogs
stops.meaning: an Inuit person, later an Arctic sled dog

stops.note: shortened form settled as the name of the northern sled-dog breed
stops.meaning: a strong Arctic sled dog breed

current_meaning: a strong, thick-coated dog breed originally used for pulling sleds in Arctic regions
